scripts.dev:logs: docker compose logs -f frontend backend ai
scripts.setup:model: docker compose run --build --rm --no-deps ai npm run setup:model -w @wisen/ai
scripts.collect: docker compose exec -T backend node apps/backend/src/cli.js collect
scripts.search: docker compose exec -T backend node apps/backend/src/cli.js search
scripts.test:integration: docker compose run --rm -e TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://wisen:wisen_local@database:5432/postgres backend npm run test:integration:local
